notes: Direct fetch throughout (no WAF; robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow, matches prior Home-Decor pass note). No dedicated /pets landing page in nav or sitemap -- HipVan has no deep Pet Care sub-taxonomy (no separate litter/leash/carrier/toy leaf categories); pet products are rolled into two general collections. Scanned sitemaps/collections.xml.gz (full text search for 'pet') plus homepage nav HTML for any missed 'Pets' nav entry -- none found beyond what's listed below. Found: /beds/pet-beds (H1 'Pet Beds & Accessories', 26 items) and /furniture-all/pet-furniture (H1 'Pet Furniture', 26 items) -- verified via product-href diff these are the SAME underlying taxon/collection: identical declared count (26 items) on both, and page1 product sets overlap 23/24 (only 1 product differs, consistent with a rotating/recommended sort drawing from the same ~26-item pool rather than two distinct pools). A third URL /furniture-all/pet-beds-1 also resolves to the identical H1 'Pet Beds & Accessories' + '26 items' (confirmed same taxon, third nav alias). Per dedup rule, emitted as ONE row (kept /beds/pet-beds as canonical link; content is genuine Tier-1 pet care: water fountains, feeding bowls, pet carriers, tents, grooming vacuums, self-cleaning cat litter boxes, cat harness/leash, cat toys, pet beds). DROPPED as brand-facet subsets of that same 26-item pool (site's own established duplicate pattern, all member products cross-checked as present in the beds/pet-beds set): /petsnowy (2 items -- PetSnowy self-cleaning litter box + pet dryer) and /smartpaw (5 items -- SmartPaw feeders/fountain/camera). EXCLUDED as human furniture only incidentally 'pet-friendly' (scratch-resistant fabric, not products made for pets -- matches brief's explicit exclusion of pet-themed/pet-friendly marketing): /sofas/pet-friendly-sofas (125 items, H1 'Pet Friendly Sofas', desc 'pet-friendly sofas...scratch-resistant fabric...for you and your furry friends') and /beds/pet-friendly-beds (2 items, human bed frames marketed as pet-friendly). No pet food/consumable category found. No medical/veterinary pet category found. Pagination via ?page=2 on /beds/pet-beds returned an identical product set to page 1 (not a true second page), so qty is taken from the site's own rendered '26 items' listing-banner count rather than a raw distinct-href tally, per Rule 2's preference for the rendered header.
